name: privacyIDEA Community Self-Hosted Multi-Factor Authentication
free_limit: AGPL-3.0-licensed self-hosted MFA server and FreeRADIUS plugin with no technical core community-edition user limit; supports OTP, WebAuthn/FIDO2 and integrations with existing identity stores.
watch_out: Self-operated server, database, HTTPS, support and hardware/SMS/email delivery are not free. Some separately distributed integration plugins have user-count or subscription limits (including Windows Credential Provider and ADFS); AGPL-3.0 network-source obligations apply to modified deployments.
